name: MMLP Jalna
capacity_notes: Operational; commercial operations commenced June 2026 per NHLML; first NHLML park to open; serves Marathwada dry-port hinterland

name: MMLP Chennai (Mappedu)
operator: NHLML / Reliance Industries Ltd (DP World 49% stake)
capacity_notes: Awarded and under development; 184 acres at Mappedu ~52 km from Chennai Port; ~Rs 1424 crore; first MMLP awarded under PM Gati Shakti; Phase-1 targeted ~2026

name: MMLP Bengaluru (Muddalinganahalli)

capacity_notes: Awarded and under construction since Mar 2024; ~400 acres; ~Rs 1770 crore; 45-year DBFOT concession; ~30 MMT cargo by end of concession
